n: Hand Pose Detector and FaceMesh demos
t: Two webcam demos that draw hand and face landmarks in real time.
steps: Open the AI4K12 page and find the Hand Pose Detector and FaceMesh links.
Open each demo in a browser to test it first.
Ask IT to allow the hosted demo pages.
Check that the webcam works on student devices.
Allow webcam access in the browser.
Read what the demo page says about data use.
Run the demo with a small group first.
